content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with a [product_name] module ([article_no]) running firmware version [version_no]. I'm using [product_name] software [version_no]. After entering the IP address of the [product_name] base module in my browser, the URL changes to '192.168.1.47/logo_variable_01.shtm' and the page cannot be found, with no clear cause. The same issue occurs with another identical module. I also loaded a project created with [product_name] Web Editor onto the SD card. Accessing the custom site works fine. For the base module online settings: - Access passwords for [product_name] Soft Comfort and [product_name] Web Editor are enabled - HTTP webserver access is enabled - Web user access is enabled - Operator device access is enabled (though disabling this option causes some issues) The SD card used is 4GB formatted with Fat32. Could someone advise how to resolve problems accessing the webserver on the [product_name] base module? Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter a problem accessing the webserver of the [product_name] base module in a browser, as the device's IP address redirect results in a 'not found' page. Accessing a custom page loaded from an SD card works, and all relevant access settings are enabled. The issue occurs with multiple devices and with specified firmware, software, and SD card configurations. Clearing the browser cache is suggested as part of the troubleshooting process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects consistent and successful webserver access to the [product_name] base module via its IP address in a browser, and wants to reach the default web pages served by the module.
